findings.explanation: 29876 is column 2 to 29881 in the NCCI PTP edits, with modifier indicator 1. Without XS or 59 the line bundles automatically. The op note supports XS (separate structure): the synovectomy was performed in the suprapatellar pouch, patellofemoral compartment and lateral gutter, all separate from the medial meniscectomy.

findings.issue: Diagnosis pointer for line 2 is correct
findings.explanation: M65.861 (synovitis, right lower leg) supports 29876; keep it as the primary pointer for line 2.
RT is correctly appended on both lines; keep it.

appeal_argument: Per Pinnacle RP-114 Section 4, 29876 is separately reimbursable with 29881 when the synovectomy is performed in a separate compartment, the op note documents it, and XS/59 is billed. The operative report documents major synovectomy of the suprapatellar pouch, patellofemoral compartment and lateral gutter through a separate superolateral portal, and states that no synovectomy was performed in the medial compartment where the meniscectomy occurred. Line 2 has been corrected to 29876-XS-RT.
documentation_support: Op note: 'major synovectomy of the lateral compartment/lateral gutter, suprapatellar pouch and patellofemoral compartment'; 'No synovectomy was performed in the medial compartment'; separate superolateral portal; about 25 minutes added. Pathology: chronic proliferative synovitis.
